▌ A standfirst lead paragraph that introduces the piece and runs long enough to 
▌ wrap across the narrower widths so the left accent bar is visible on every    
▌ continuation line.

▌ Every block type is a self-contained renderer that, given a width and a theme,
▌ returns styled lines.

Slug

Summary                                                                         
A multi-line summary field whose value is long enough to wrap under the bold    
label line when the width is narrow.
